newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bomb wounds civilian in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Bomb wounds civilian in south Lebanon.

text.p: A roadside bomb exploded in south Lebanon on Sunday, wounding a civilian motorist, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

The South Lebanon Army (SLA) sources said the blast took place on a road near the town of Jezzine in a finger of territory extending northwards from Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone but under Israeli control.
It was not immediately known who was behind the blast. Pro-Iranian Moslem guerrillas wage attacks against Israeli and SLA targets in a bid to drive them out from the south Lebanon zone.
